hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 ETH/phiEth custom swap curve via beforeSwap, bypassing concentrated liquidity. On each swap the hook takes the full input from the pool manager, converts between ETH and phiEth through the phiEth contract, and settles the output directly. Liquidity addition is permanently blocked; only ETH/phiEth pairs with zero fee are permitted.
